purpose: Isolate deterministic validation enforcement timing on identical retained M3 traces.
changed_factor: order in which the retained pre-plan validation result is enforced at the system release boundary

policies.early_preplan_enforcement: Apply first-call backend and ledger validity before the retained final generation can determine the released system disposition. The second call remains a shadow call for pairing and is not interpreted as operational early-stopping compute.
policies.deferred_release_enforcement: Interpret the retained final generation first; if it requests EXECUTE, apply the identical retained ledger result and post-plan validator before release. A model CLARIFY or BLOCK is preserved.

interpretation_limits: This is a paired trace-replay ablation, not new model inference.
It identifies the effect of deterministic enforcement order conditional on the retained M3 transcripts.
It does not estimate latency or energy savings from operational early termination because both retained calls already occurred.
It does not establish simulator execution success or physical mission success.
It does not test a second model family.
